title: NeoMME：高效的多模态原生多语言编码器
summary: NeoMME 是一种高效的多模态原生多语言编码器，旨在统一处理文本、图像、音频和视频等多种模态，同时支持多语言理解。该模型基于 Transformer 架构，采用统一的 tokenizer 和编码器结构，将不同模态的输入映射到共享的语义空间，从而实现跨模态和跨语言的联合表示学习。NeoMME 在训练中使用了大规模多模态多语言数据集，并引入了模态对齐和语言自适应机制，以提升跨模态检索、视觉问答、语音识别和机器翻译等任务的性能。实验结果表明，NeoMME 在多个基准数据集上优于现有的多模态编码器，同时显著降低了计算成本和参数量，使其更适合实际部署。该模型已在 Hugging Face 平台上开源，提供了预训练权重和微调脚本，方便研究者和开发者使用。NeoMME 的设计强调效率与通用性，为多模态 AI 系统提供了一种新的基础架构选择。
summary_en: NeoMME is an efficient multimodal-native and multilingual encoder designed to jointly process text, image, audio, and video modalities while supporting multiple languages. Built on a Transformer architecture, it uses a unified tokenizer and encoder to map different modalities into a shared semantic space, enabling cross-modal and cross-lingual representation learning. The model is trained on large-scale multimodal multilingual datasets and incorporates modality alignment and language adaptation mechanisms to improve performance on tasks such as cross-modal retrieval, visual question answering, speech recognition, and machine translation. Experimental results show that NeoMME outperforms existing multimodal encoders on several benchmarks while significantly reducing computational cost and parameter count, making it suitable for real-world deployment. The model is open-sourced on Hugging Face, providing pretrained weights and fine-tuning scripts for researchers and developers. NeoMME emphasizes efficiency and versatility, offering a new foundational architecture for multimodal AI systems.
